label: Late original-phase tokens in sequences starting with b or q (very sparse, conjunctive)
explanation: Fires almost only in the original (input) phase (98.5% of mass), at positions 4-8, mostly on the last 1-3 tokens before <DEL>. It is strongly gated by the first token of the sequence: b (15.6x lift, 53% of mass) or q (9.2x, 30%), and weakly 3. The predicate (original phase, first token b/q, t>=4) covers about 80% of activations and mass, but precision is under 1%: the feature fires on only a tiny fraction of those steps. Firing is more likely when the current input is one of a/c/h/o/w/f (first occurrence) and when k, u, v or 2 appeared earlier (e.g. b k v j k 2 [c], q k u v n [d] [w]). Adding those conditions raises precision to about 14% but drops recall to about 40% (best dev F1 about 0.21), so the exact conjunction stays unresolved. Near-silent at t<3, in the copy phase, and on <DEL>. Magnitude is small (max 0.23); I found no clean magnitude driver beyond the top examples matching more of these conditions.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=b (+5.40), orig0=q (+4.76), orig0=3 (+3.36), orig1=k (+3.03), orig2=k (+2.97), prev_tok=d (+2.82). Lower it: prev3_tok=- (-3.93), orig_idx=-1 (-3.12), phase=2 (-1.87), orig_idx=3 (-1.43).
